items.headline: ArtStation Has New Owners Who Say They'll Put Artists First By Blocking AI Scrapers
items.excerpt: 'ArtStation is making protection against AI training the default.'

items.headline: Kingdom Come: Deliverance director says DLSS 5 does right by KCD 2, people are 'crazy' for thinking it's AI slop
items.excerpt: The controversial generative AI upscaling tech can look alright when used subtly, but the 'AI look' seems inescapable to many players.

items.headline: CD Projekt Red isn't 'planning to rely on AI making complete games', and will still be 'predominantly using people' for The Witcher 4
items.excerpt: "I think everybody has to make those judgments on their own," says the studio on generative AI in production.

items.headline: Nvidia DLSS 5 Launches on September 3, Debuts in NBA 2K27
items.excerpt: It might be time to see your favorite athletes in a whole new, photorealistic light as DLSS 5 brings its magic to a title that can use it well.

items.headline: Nvidia says it's only targeting 'photorealistic' games with DLSS 5, but am I the only one who thinks 'realistic' visuals are worse?
items.excerpt: Nvidia assured me it's only intending DLSS 5 to be used in photorealistic games, but I thought we were past thinking realistic graphics were better.

items.headline: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 lead says the DLSS 5 backlash is 'really funny' and that 'most talented people I know use AI'
items.excerpt: A senior dev pushes back on the anti-AI mood, saying the most talented people he knows already use AI in their craft.

items.headline: Dwarf Fortress creator says we have a natural lean towards human-made stories, 'but we're all going to be very sorely tested in the coming years' by AI
items.excerpt: Tarn Adams argues players instinctively prefer human-authored stories, but expects that instinct to be tested hard as generative systems improve.

items.headline: DLSS 5 Now Works on RTX 20 & 30 GPUs, Older Graphics APIs and Even PCSX2
items.excerpt: Modders enable NVIDIA's leaked DLSS 5 on RTX 20, 30, and more, enhancing older games and emulators with improved neural rendering performance.
